node.text: &w*Man Opener chirps.*~ &w*Man Opener ducks her head, asking for pets.*~ &w*Man Opener scuffs the ground with her horns.*~ &w*Man Opener has something in her mouth, but won't let you see it.*~ &w*Man Opener snorts.*~ &w*Man Opener growls happily.*~ &w*Man Opener watches you intently.*~ &w*Man Opener frolics.*~ &w*Man Opener chews a broken axe haft she won during a previous battle.*~ &w*Man Opener chews half a helmet she won during a previous battle.*~ &w*Man Opener is chewing a hand she won during a previous battle.*~ &w*Man Opener directs a wistful gaze toward the horizon.*
